source_excerpts.text:
Individual stem strength

Clearance prevents assuming that two stems always share shear equally. I therefore screened each stem against the full 1,000 N endpoint.

For the minimum diameter, a 4.25 mm bearing lever, 450 N axial load and an introduced bending concentration factor of 1.5, the model returns:

Screen	Equivalent stress
Reference shear plus self-load	559 MPa
1.25× shear proof plus self-load	693 MPa

The finite-bearing interpretation matters. Increasing the effective lever to 5.75 mm raises those values to approximately 741 and 920 MPa, and reduces the bare-stem stiffness to approximately 68.5 MN/m.

Consequently, a nominal shear-area calculation is inadequate. The actual pressure distribution in the guide and receiver must determine the bearing resultants.
